{"program":"domain(person,[tate]).
% Tate acts on impulse.
axiom(s1, acts_on_impulse(tate)).
% Tate achieves success.
axiom(s2, achieves_success(tate)).
% Tate either prioritizes leisure or works tirelessly, but not both.
axiom(s3, xor(prioritizes_leisure(tate), works_tirelessly(tate))).
% If Tate is ambitious, then he either prioritizes leisure or enjoys freedom, but not both.
axiom(s4, rule([ambitious(tate)], xor(prioritizes_leisure(tate), enjoys_freedom(tate)))).
% Tate does not enjoy freedom.
axiom(s5, not(enjoys_freedom(tate))).
% Tate has career goals.
axiom(s6, has_career_goals(tate)).
% If Tate pursues his passion, then he is either dedicated or achieves success, but not both.
axiom(s7, rule([pursues_passion(tate)], xor(dedicated(tate), achieves_success(tate)))).
% For Tate, he either acts on impulse or thinks critically, but not both.
axiom(s8, xor(acts_on_impulse(tate), thinks_critically(tate))).
% If Tate loves nature, then he prioritizes leisure.
axiom(s9, rule([loves_nature(tate)], prioritizes_leisure(tate))).
% Tate is ambitious.
axiom(s10, ambitious(tate)).
% Tate does not have strong motivation.
axiom(s11, not(has_strong_motivation(tate))).
% If Tate has career goals, then he either has strong motivation or pursues his passion, but not both.
axiom(s12, rule([has_career_goals(tate)], xor(has_strong_motivation(tate), pursues_passion(tate)))).","query":"labelled_explanation(becomes_expert(tate), Status, Package)"}
